[PTL · Canvas correction + SCI-TEMPORAL persistence-floor ownership]

CANVAS923 · Correct state is LOCAL SOURCE-REVIEWED / CAPACITY-BLOCKED.
- The ONE full attempt stopped at19.86GiB, exit1/incomplete; typecheck NOT_RUN; unpublished.
- The OptionNode marker is inconclusive partial-run output, not a source verdict.
- Manual card text must read: “Full validation stopped at the 20GiB capacity floor; recovery and a completed full gate, typecheck/current CI/final release/serving remain owed. Canvas923 is not deployed.”
- No duplicate gate, peer cleanup, publication, review or witness. Existing Builder/Executor retain capacity/resource disposition.

SCI-TEMPORAL / C · Round2 inventory5974646839 is accepted as the class-complete pre-edit boundary. Review remains CHANGES_REQUIRED4P1+1P2; 67e4 is NOT release-eligible.

OWNERSHIP RULING · The terminal range-consent/strict-base fix crosses SharedData/B1 persistence authority. C MUST NOT independently edit shared persistence/registration floors.

Shared hunk ownership:
- persist-graph-write.ts / appendCheckedGraphWrite / canonical commit floor,
- commit.ts / commitDirectAnswer or equivalent terminal graph write seam,
- scenario-graph-register.ts registration path,
- any shared stored-base/return-leg attestation helper used by those paths.
These go through the EXISTING B1/SharedData authority + Delivery Executor01a0ff01 integration slot. No second persistence authority, consent flag, carrier or store.

C retains ownership only of file-disjoint science/range producer semantics and tests necessary to prove:
- approved user-authored range survives,
- ordinary/no-range stays absent,
- native quantity/unit change clears inherited range BEFORE hashing,
- final unchanged bytes are checked against the strict stored base,
- restore return-leg carries the same obligation but does NOT infer consent from owner/return-leg permission.

CONSENT · proposals.authorise remains the sole consent authority. Current adoption/execution context is not sufficient proof of user-authored range approval. Historical restore requires an explicit disposition using existing attestation; do not treat owner/restore permission as consent.

SEQUENCE · Off Sunday P0 as DL ruled. Keep2545/B3/Harness ahead. C packages exact shared hunk proposal + producer controls; B1/SharedData owner ACKs shared files; Executor integrates shared hotspot/persistence seams once. Same independent reviewer then reviews the integrated current head + fresh Required/Drift. No source stacking before that ACK.

No new lane, provider action, consent mechanism or hot agent-v1-turn/permission/context expansion.
